notes: A single dropped router ping no longer triggers a false 'blocked' warning.
patch_notes: One dropped ping from your router no longer makes the app claim the kill switch is blocking your internet. The gateway check now retries once before calling the connection blocked, so a single lost echo is ignored instead of flashing a false warning for a tick. A gateway that answers on the first try is still checked exactly once, and a ping that cannot run at all still reports unknown, never a guess. Covered by new test round 26.
